body:
The standard `vm-qa` cloud-folder walks still assume CHANGE CLOUD FOLDER opens the saves keyboard directly. Current ES `1d76b3da7da75794066df1c089931b890304da7a` opens CLOUD FOLDERS first, with separate saves/settings/content rows (`GuiMenu.cpp` cloudOpenFolderSettings). The canonical menu/flow documents already describe this intermediate page. `tools/vm-walks/to-change-cloud-folder.steps` currently labels that intermediate-page capture `folder-editor`, and `confirm-cloud-folder.steps` then sends the old keyboard submission sequence. Actual replacement18 reproduction confirms the harness/reference mismatch: the old editor capture is CLOUD FOLDERS, START then closes to the carousel, and A opens the FBNeo game list. The old walk returned without a command error but failed its intended screen contract. No product navigation defect is claimed.

Found while preparing the final standard suites after #526. Archaeology checked the work-log/history and issue search; the only matching tracker was closed #78, about provider refusal rather than the current path-selection page. Completed #507 is not being repeated.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. The actual installed ES UI, synthetic local WebDAV, current path values and emitted reviewed frames supply the evidence. No personal device/cloud action is needed.

Already written: only test steps/reference expectations are stale. Existing player settings, selected paths and cloud payloads require no migration or repair. Keep original executed failures as failures.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Reproduce the old walk mismatch on the installed replacement18 image, retaining exact image/ES/source identity, original command/result and intended-versus-observed frame evidence.
- [ ] Update the standard navigation composition and outcome assertions for the current independent path selector/editor/return behavior. Preserve selected-path and payload witnesses; retain a discriminating old-step control.
- [ ] Review happy-path/branch frames at the relevant target sizes, update canonical flow/menu references and the accompanying screenshot index, and classify expected frame differences with bounded evidence rather than a blanket mask.
- [ ] Run affected standard walks/frame comparisons successfully on the same immutable image using a separately frozen, published QA harness; retain all unaffected suite results with their original source. Update #508/M7, work/friction logs and checkpoint. No product rebuild is needed unless actual product bytes change.

Priority: after replacement18 installed #526/CF10 and actual retained-storage upgrade proof, before final standard VM/protocol acceptance and H700 → SM8550. #519 remains before owner handheld deployment.


Current 2026-10-08: [original frames and direct review](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/78fef6c6cc3034c82c98aeee5091cea3e8ce0827/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-cloud-folder-walks) are published. QA-only source `2e484871bd` fixes editor entry/unchanged return and adds config/path/local/cloud hash witnesses. The isolated640×480 run passes with every original result channel0 and actual owner processes exited; its five confirmation-flow frames were directly reviewed. A fresh1280×800 continuation is running. No firmware/source overlay was used. Final publication, bounded frame comparison and full-suite/protocol acceptance remain open. Two pre-execution watcher launch refusals are retained as rc2, not guest failures.
